title: Project Skeleton + Error Registry
description: Initialize SYNAPSE Python project with standard directory structure, pyproject.toml, and centralized error code registry.
action: Create synapse/ Python package with: (1) pyproject.toml with dependencies: pandas, numpy, pyyaml, pytest; (2) synapse/core/errors.py with error code classes: DATA_MISSING_FIELD, DATA_INVALID_TIME_RANGE, DATA_AVAILABLE_AT_MISSING, FACTOR_INVALID_SPEC, FACTOR_COMPUTE_FAILED, EXPERIMENT_RECORD_MISSING, BACKTEST_CONFIG_INVALID, GOVERNANCE_LEAKAGE_RISK, AGENT_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, REPORT_ARTIFACT_MISSING; (3) synapse/core/config.py with YAML config loader; (4) synapse/core/workspace.py with project directory initialization; (5) Standard directories: data/sample/, factors/, experiments/, backtests/, reports/, artifacts/, configs/; (6) configs/default.yaml with project metadata template.
implementation: Create pyproject.toml: name='synapse', version='0.1.0', requires-python='>=3.11', dependencies=['pandas>=2.0', 'numpy>=1.24', 'pyyaml>=6.0', 'pytest>=7.0']
Create synapse/core/errors.py: define SynapseError base class, each error code as a subclass with code string and default message matching docs/04_contracts/06_Error_Codes.md
Create synapse/core/config.py: load_config(path) function that reads YAML and returns dict, validate_config(config) that checks required keys
Create synapse/core/workspace.py: init_workspace(path) that creates standard directories, check_workspace(path) that verifies structure exists
Create configs/default.yaml with fields: project_name, domain (cross_sectional_equity), created_at, data_dir, factor_dir, experiment_dir

criteria: python -c 'from synapse.core.errors import DATA_MISSING_FIELD; print(DATA_MISSING_FIELD.code)' outputs DATA_MISSING_FIELD
